svg.title: SGLang KDA state-trace MVP timeline
svg.desc: Request A moves from allocation through prefill and two decode steps while token locations grow and recurrent slot 5 stays fixed. A separate depth-256 prefix forks by copying cached slot 12 into active slots 8 and 9.
